mintAuthority.summary: trUSD's token minter is the verified ToriMinting contract. Three operator EOAs can execute signed, whitelisted, collateral-transfer-backed orders within per-block caps; a 3-of-5 Safe can raise those caps or authorize operators, while a one-day timelock can replace the token minter or UUPS implementation.

controls.label: ToriMinting token minter
controls.capDescription: Minting is bounded to 5,000,000 trUSD per block globally and per active collateral asset at observation; orders also require a live operator, whitelisted participant, valid signature and custody route, active supported asset, collateral-ratio check, and actual collateral transfer.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712112, trUSD minter() returned this verified contract, which was unpaused. Verified source permits mint only through MINTER_ROLE operators and enforces a signed order, participant whitelist, custody route, active collateral, per-asset and global block caps, and transfer of USDC or USDT before calling token mint. The global and each active-asset mint cap were 5000000000000000000000000, or 5,000,000 trUSD per block.

controls.label: ToriMinting operator 1
controls.capDescription: This operator can submit only ToriMinting orders that pass the shared signed-order, whitelist, collateral-transfer, and per-block cap checks.
controls.evidence: A complete MINTER_ROLE RoleGranted/RoleRevoked replay followed by hasRole() at Ethereum block 25712112 confirmed this EOA as a live operator. It cannot call trUSD mint directly and cannot alter ToriMinting caps or gates.

controls.evidence: A complete MINTER_ROLE RoleGranted/RoleRevoked replay followed by hasRole() at Ethereum block 25712112 confirmed this EOA as a live operator. It cannot call trUSD mint directly and cannot alter ToriMinting caps or gates.

controls.label: Tori administration Safe
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712112, this Safe held ToriMinting DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and the trUSD token's default-admin role. Safe state was 3-of-5, version 1.4.1, with no modules and zero guard. It can grant or revoke ToriMinting operators and change global, per-asset, custody, and participant controls, including raising the 5,000,000-per-block mint caps.

controls.label: trUSD UUPS and minter-replacement timelock
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712112, this verified ToriTimelock held token TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE and getMinDelay() returned 86400 seconds. Verified TrUSD source gates both setMinter and UUPS _authorizeUpgrade through TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE, so the timelock can replace the current ToriMinting contract or the entire mint implementation after the delay. The Tori administration Safe held the timelock's proposer and executor roles.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712112, the trUSD UUPS proxy used implementation 0xb1d133fe29255eb4ac9b05d647d49cd7f05ff631 and minter 0xe16b821b9f6b0a6f06a2c4a61d5d1f71cfa53f1e. Complete role-event replay plus direct hasRole reads found three live ToriMinting operator EOAs. Verified source bounds their calls by signed orders, participant and custody allowlists, active USDC/USDT collateral, actual collateral transfer, and 5,000,000-trUSD global and per-asset per-block caps. The 3-of-5 Safe can grant operators and raise the contract caps; the one-day timelock can replace either the token minter or implementation, so economic cap semantics are raiseable. Accountable publishes a continuously refreshed proof-of-solvency view but is not a prudential supervisor, supporting continuous reconciliation and attestation-only supervision.
